card.name: Negation and absence wording in results
card.fires_on: Words right after a negation or at a spot where a null result is stated, such as 'no evidence', 'no poems,', 'none of', or 'reduced or unchanged'. Also fires on some partway-through-number or word positions.

modes.label: Absence of findings
modes.description: The word 'evidence' after 'no' in study results about lack of harm or effect.
modes.example: revealed no<< evidence>> of impaired fertility or harm to the fetus

modes.label: None or unchanged
modes.description: Words expressing nothing or no change, like 'none' or 'unchanged'.
modes.example: clearance of verapamil was either reduced or<< unchanged>>. No clinically significant pharmacokinetic interaction

modes.label: Inside numbers or long words
modes.description: Digits, decimal points or word middles where the text continues with a small quantity or an unusual word.

card.writes: It suppresses words like 'unexpectedly' and 'surprisingly', so it favors plain, expected continuations.
card.plain: It lights up where a text says something was absent or unchanged, as in 'no evidence of harm'.
